spans.s: गोल (cf. गुड) m. A ball, Bhāg.

; of the Kadamba's flower, Mālat. p. 116.
 --Cf. गुड.
 --Comp.

गोल + क, m.
 1. A ball, as the Kadamba's round flower, Bhāṣāp. p. 165 (v. r.); ऊ-, m. The earth, Bhāg.
गोलोमतस्, i. e. गो-लोमन् + तस्, adv. From cow's hair, Pañc. i. d. 107.
+ लोक गो- + लोक, m. Kṛṣṇa's heaven.
